ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in Southern Africa changed by +0.232 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.151 to +0.308), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.572 °C.

cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in Southern Africa changed by +0.19 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval 0.00 to +0.37), which is statistically significant (p = 0.04). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.47 kg/m².

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in Southern Africa shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.15): the estimate is −0.010 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.023 to +0.003). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)

This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
